title: Claude-only pool config: codex rows off, claude:sonnet row (1-5), claude:opus 6-10, models.sonnet claude-sonnet-5-5
spec:
Why: the human is cancelling Codex (2026-09-30); executors become Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5. Codex stays in config so re-subscribing is a flag flip.
What, in .orchestrator/pool.toml only:
- astra, luna, terra, sol: enabled = false, each with a comment `# 2026-09-30 T-1403: Codex subscription cancelled; revert: true`. luna6/terra6/sol6 are already false.
- New [[executors]] row id "claude:sonnet", provider "claude", model = the models.sonnet value, roles ["execute"], complexity_min 1, complexity_max 5, max_parallel 3, daily_budget_tasks 40, quota_group "claude", weight 1.0, enabled true. Mirror the claude:opus row's keys exactly (pool.py:196-201 validates that a claude row's model equals models[tier]).
- claude:opus row: complexity_min 6 (was 1), weight 1.0 (was 0.1 if so), keep the rest.
- [models] sonnet = "claude-sonnet-5-5" (was claude-sonnet-5). This intentionally moves reviews, spec reviews and scouts that use the sonnet tier to Sonnet 5.5 too.
- KEEP [codex] on_exhausted = "fallback_claude": until task B2 lands, a saturated Claude pool would otherwise hold tasks (executor.py:551-555).
Test in tests/test_pool.py (read the real repo pool.toml through the existing loader, not a fixture).

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused acceptance test in the foreground (uv run python -m pytest <id> -q). Never background a command and never run the full gate; the daemon gates externally. Acceptance ids are tests/<file>.py::<function or method name>; write the test as a unittest.TestCase method using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests.
acceptance: tests/test_pool.py::test_repo_config_routes_claude_only passes: loading the repo pool.toml, every codex row (astra, luna, terra, sol, luna6, terra6, sol6) has enabled false, claude:sonnet (model = models.sonnet = claude-sonnet-5-5) covers complexity 1-5 and claude:opus covers 6-10, and pick_executor returns claude:sonnet for c3 and claude:opus for c8 when an account has headroom
